scope: deterministic currency arithmetic, ownership transfer, rollback, and persistence foundation

sources.observations: WCCBANKS.DAT exists as a 1536-byte native bank data source with 40 non-zero bytes and no recovered ASCII strings.
Existing runtime already establishes non-negative carried/banked balances, checked credits, guarded debits, transactional rollback, ledger snapshots, and trade ownership boundaries.

assumptions: All configured denominations are exact positive integer multiples of one base unit.
Canonical change uses descending denomination value and never creates fractional units.
fallback: Reject unknown denominations, negative values, arithmetic overflow, inconsistent snapshots, and transfers that cannot be committed atomically.
runtimeImpact: Adds deterministic multi-denomination wallet arithmetic and atomic ownership transfer without assigning unsupported MajorMUD ratios.
saveImpact: Adds versioned wallet snapshots and strict JSON validation.
worldImpact: Prevents duplication, underflow, partial transfer, and overflow across character, merchant, bank, corpse, NPC, party, or world wallets once those owners bind to this wallet model.
